verdict.reasons: The candidate successfully integrates the authoritative white-and-blue AFP drip-tape carton into a coherent agricultural setting. Branding on the main cylinder is legible, authentic, and consistent with the reference guide. The 'Drip Irrigation Tape' caption and Persian text are appropriately readable. While the installed lateral line appears slightly more circular or hose-like than typical flat tape, this is a minor technical imperfection (advisory level) that does not rise to a core defect, as the primary subject is the commercial carton roll. The image passes with a high score, reflecting a well-composed, high-quality editorial asset.

focused_physical_review.reason: The black irrigation line is visible emerging from the base of the carton in the left detail view, satisfying the condition of touching or crossing the package. Additionally, there is a distinct, separate coiled section of tubing sitting on the soil immediately adjacent to the carton, which counts as an extra loose product coil. The gap behind the package is obscured by the line and lack of clear soil, and no protruding tape or strip is visible on the carton sides.
